description: Searches the free KrakenShield Knowledge Center: cybersecurity glossary, acronyms, security certifications (CISSP, OSCP, ISO 27001...) and the "Cyber from A to Z" guide. Returns short passages with the URL of each page to cite. Use a few precise keywords.

language.description: Language of the answer: "fr" for French, "en" for English (default). Use the language of the conversation.

query.description: A few keywords, e.g. "HSTS preload" or "NIS2 obligations".

name: search_cyber_knowledge
title: Search the KrakenShield cybersecurity library
